roots.descriptionZh: 从集合语言、形式推理到结构与映射的组织方式。三条主线互相联系；年代标记说明分支形成背景，不为每个词条断代。
roots.descriptionEn: Sets, formal reasoning, and the organization of structures and maps. The three branches interact; period labels describe the emergence of a field, not the date of every listed concept.

children.descriptionZh: 从集合、映射和无穷大小，进入公理化及描述集合论。
children.descriptionEn: From sets, maps, and sizes of infinity to axiomatization and descriptive set theory.

children.descriptionZh: 集合的元素、子集、集合族以及并、交、积。
children.descriptionEn: Elements, subsets, families, unions, intersections, and products.

children.descriptionZh: 函数与关系的集合论表达及等价类。
children.descriptionEn: Set-theoretic functions, relations, and equivalence classes.

children.descriptionZh: 序关系、良序以及超限递归所依赖的序数结构。
children.descriptionEn: Order relations, well-orders, and ordinal structures underlying transfinite recursion.

children.descriptionZh: 可数性、连续统与大小不同的无穷集合。
children.descriptionEn: Countability, the continuum, and different sizes of infinite sets.

children.descriptionZh: 公理系统回应集合论悖论，并研究选择原理和独立命题。
children.descriptionEn: Axiom systems addressing set-theoretic paradoxes, choice principles, and independent statements.
children.periodZh: 20世纪初公理化，随后发展独立性研究
children.periodEn: Axiomatization in the early twentieth century, followed by independence research

children.descriptionZh: 集合的拓扑复杂性、无穷组合结构及选择公理的后果。
children.descriptionEn: Topological complexity of sets, infinitary combinatorics, and consequences of choice.

children.periodEn: Emergence in the late nineteenth century; continuing development

sources.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy: The Early Development of Set Theory

children.descriptionZh: 从命题、量词和证明发展到模型、可计算性及类型。
children.descriptionEn: From propositions, quantifiers, and proofs to models, computability, and types.

children.descriptionZh: 命题及谓词语言、量化、真值和经典推理。
children.descriptionEn: Propositional and predicate languages, quantification, truth values, and classical inference.

children.descriptionZh: 推理规则、公理系统及完备性、不完备性和独立性。
children.descriptionEn: Inference rules, axiom systems, completeness, incompleteness, and independence.

children.descriptionZh: 形式语言的解释、模型构造和模型间的比较。
children.descriptionEn: Interpretations of formal languages, construction of models, and comparison between models.

children.descriptionZh: 有效计算的形式模型、递归层级以及不可判定性。
children.descriptionEn: Formal models of effective calculation, recursive hierarchies, and undecidability.

children.descriptionZh: 从函数演算、构造性证明到依赖类型与同伦类型论。
children.descriptionEn: From calculi of functions and constructive proofs to dependent types and homotopy type theory.

children.descriptionZh: 类型论在程序语言中的结构、推导和语义应用。
children.descriptionEn: Structures, inference, and semantics of types in programming languages.

children.zh: 非经典逻辑与代数语义
children.descriptionZh: 直觉主义、模态、线性等逻辑及其代数与关系语义。
children.descriptionEn: Intuitionistic, modal, linear, and related logics, with algebraic and relational semantics.

children.periodZh: 19世纪符号化，20世纪形成现代分支
children.periodEn: Symbolic development in the nineteenth century; modern branches in the twentieth

sources.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy: Frege’s Logic

children.descriptionZh: 由对象与态射的统一语言，发展到泛性质、层和高阶结构。
children.descriptionEn: From the language of objects and morphisms to universal properties, sheaves, and higher structures.

children.descriptionZh: 范畴论的基本语言，以及常用的范畴构造。
children.descriptionEn: The basic categorical language and constructions of categories.

children.descriptionZh: 用映射性质刻画对象，比较函子并组织极限构造。
children.descriptionEn: Characterization by maps, comparison of functors, and organization of limit constructions.

children.zh: 加性、阿贝尔与导出范畴
children.descriptionZh: 范畴论组织线性结构、正合性和同调代数。
children.descriptionEn: Categorical organization of linear structures, exactness, and homological algebra.

children.descriptionZh: 由张量运算连接代数、表示论和量子拓扑。
children.descriptionEn: Tensor operations linking algebra, representation theory, and quantum topology.

children.descriptionZh: 局部数据的粘合及其几何和逻辑组织方式。
children.descriptionEn: Gluing local data and organizing it geometrically and logically.
children.periodEn: Formation and development in the later twentieth century

children.descriptionZh: 把态射间的态射与同伦等价纳入结构。
children.descriptionEn: Structures incorporating morphisms between morphisms and homotopical equivalence.
children.periodEn: Later twentieth century onward
Emergence in the mid-twentieth century; continuing development

sources.title: nLab: General Theory of Natural Equivalences

roots.descriptionZh: 从数与方程、线性运算，走向群环域、表示与同调结构。各支按形成脉络安排，交叉结构可重复出现。
roots.descriptionEn: From numbers, equations, and linear operations to groups, rings, fields, representations, and homological structures. Branches follow broad historical development and share cross-disciplinary concepts.

children.descriptionZh: 古典计算与方程问题逐步发展为符号代数。
children.descriptionEn: Classical calculation and equation problems developing into symbolic algebra.

children.descriptionZh: 整数、有理数与复数等数系，以及加乘运算的基本结构。
children.descriptionEn: Integers, rationals, complex numbers, and structures underlying arithmetic operations.

children.descriptionZh: 从多项式运算到方程的根、判别式和消元。
children.descriptionEn: From polynomial operations to roots, discriminants, and elimination.

children.periodZh: 古代问题传统；近代符号化
children.periodEn: Ancient problem traditions; symbolic development in the early modern era

sources.title: University of St Andrews, MacTutor: Quadratic, cubic and quartic equations

children.descriptionZh: 线性方程与行列式的计算，发展为向量空间和线性变换理论。
children.descriptionEn: Calculations with linear equations and determinants developing into vector spaces and linear transformations.

children.descriptionZh: 线性组合、基、维数以及子空间和商空间。
children.descriptionEn: Linear combinations, bases, dimension, subspaces, and quotient spaces.

children.descriptionZh: 矩阵运算、行列式及矩阵的等价与分解。
children.descriptionEn: Matrix operations, determinants, equivalence, and decompositions.

children.descriptionZh: 内积几何、特征值问题与规范分解。
children.descriptionEn: Inner-product geometry, eigenvalue problems, and canonical decompositions.

children.descriptionZh: 从双线性与二次型到张量积、对称和外代数。
children.descriptionEn: From bilinear and quadratic forms to tensor products, symmetric and exterior algebras.

children.periodZh: 古代消元传统；17—19世纪形成现代结构
children.periodEn: Ancient elimination methods; modern structures developed in the seventeenth–nineteenth centuries

sources.title: University of St Andrews, MacTutor: Matrices and determinants

children.descriptionZh: 从方程的置换对称性到抽象群及其作用。
children.descriptionEn: From permutation symmetries of equations to abstract groups and their actions.

children.descriptionZh: 群运算、子群、商群和作用的基本结构。
children.descriptionEn: Basic group operations, subgroups, quotients, and actions.

children.zh: 置换、群结构与有限分类
children.en: Permutations, group structure, and finite classification
children.descriptionZh: 从置换和结构性质进入有限群与单群分类。
children.descriptionEn: From permutations and structural properties to the classification of finite and simple groups.

children.descriptionZh: 点群、空间对称性与周期晶格的代数组织。
children.descriptionEn: Algebraic organization of point groups, spatial symmetries, and periodic lattices.

children.en: Infinite groups and geometric group theory
children.descriptionZh: 生成元与关系、自由群以及群的几何与拓扑。
children.descriptionEn: Generators and relations, free groups, and geometry and topology of groups.

children.periodEn: Formation in the nineteenth century; structural development in the twentieth

sources.title: University of St Andrews, MacTutor: The abstract group concept

children.zh: 非结合与一般代数结构
children.descriptionZh: 松弛结合律等公理后的运算结构，与几何、逻辑和物理相联系。
children.descriptionEn: Algebraic structures obtained by varying axioms such as associativity, with links to geometry, logic, and physics.

children.descriptionZh: 幺半群、半群和格等由运算与恒等式描述的结构。
children.descriptionEn: Monoids, semigroups, lattices, and structures described by operations and identities.

children.zh: 超复数与克利福德代数
children.descriptionZh: 四元数、八元数和克利福德代数等数系与几何代数。
children.descriptionEn: Quaternions, octonions, Clifford algebras, and related geometric number systems.

children.periodZh: 19世纪超复数起源；20世纪一般化
children.periodEn: Nineteenth-century hypercomplex origins; twentieth-century generalization

children.descriptionZh: 由整数与多项式的算术抽象出环、理想、模和域。
children.descriptionEn: Abstracting rings, ideals, modules, and fields from integer and polynomial arithmetic.

children.descriptionZh: 环的运算、理想、因子分解与交换环的基本类别。
children.descriptionEn: Ring operations, ideals, factorization, and basic classes of commutative rings.

children.descriptionZh: 局部化、完备化、维数及理想的结构定理。
children.descriptionEn: Localization, completion, dimension, and structural theorems for ideals.

children.descriptionZh: 环上的线性结构以及代数的分解、等价与表示。
children.descriptionEn: Linear structures over rings and decompositions, equivalences, and representations of algebras.

children.descriptionZh: 多项式可解性、域扩张及其自同构群。
children.descriptionEn: Solvability of polynomial equations, field extensions, and their automorphism groups.

children.periodZh: 19世纪算术起源；20世纪初公理化
children.periodEn: Arithmetic origins in the nineteenth century; axiomatization in the early twentieth

sources.title: University of St Andrews, MacTutor: The development of Ring Theory

children.descriptionZh: 线性表示与连续对称性联系群、几何和物理。
children.descriptionEn: Linear representations and continuous symmetries linking groups, geometry, and physics.

children.descriptionZh: 李群、经典矩阵群和齐性对称性提供连接代数与几何的入口。
children.descriptionEn: Lie groups, classical matrix groups, and homogeneous symmetries linking algebra and geometry.

children.descriptionZh: 连续群、无穷小括号、根系与表示的结构。
children.descriptionEn: Continuous groups, infinitesimal brackets, root systems, and representations.

children.descriptionZh: 把群作用实现为线性变换，并用特征标与不变量研究它们。
children.descriptionEn: Realizing group actions as linear transformations and studying them through characters and invariants.

children.zh: 量子、超与无限维对称性
children.descriptionZh: 量子群、分次对称性以及无限维李代数和顶点代数。
children.descriptionEn: Quantum groups, graded symmetries, infinite-dimensional Lie algebras, and vertex algebras.
children.periodEn: Development during the twentieth century; continuing expansion
Formation in the later nineteenth century; continuing development

children.descriptionZh: 利用复形、导出构造与局部代数研究拓扑和几何。
children.descriptionEn: Complexes, derived constructions, and local algebra in topology and geometry.

children.descriptionZh: 链复形、正合性及同调不变量的基本工具。
children.descriptionEn: Chain complexes, exactness, and basic tools for homological invariants.

children.zh: 代数几何与 K 理论接口
children.en: Interfaces with algebraic geometry and K-theory
children.descriptionZh: 环与几何的对应、层及现代上同调和 K 理论。
children.descriptionEn: Correspondences between rings and geometry, sheaves, modern cohomology, and K-theory.

children.periodEn: Systematization in the mid-twentieth century; continuing development

roots.descriptionZh: 由整数与素数的问题，发展出同余、代数、分析和几何方法。
roots.descriptionEn: From questions about integers and primes to congruences and algebraic, analytic, and geometric methods.

children.descriptionZh: 整除、整数方程及同余是现代数论的历史起点。
children.descriptionEn: Divisibility, integer equations, and congruences form historical starting points for modern number theory.

children.descriptionZh: 整数因子分解、素数及其基本算术函数。
children.descriptionEn: Integer factorization, primes, and elementary arithmetic functions.

children.descriptionZh: 模算术、互反律以及整数方程的解法与猜想。
children.descriptionEn: Modular arithmetic, reciprocity laws, and solutions and conjectures for integer equations.

children.descriptionZh: 数的进位表示、数字模式、整数数列和逼近中的有理数。
children.descriptionEn: Numeral expansions, digit patterns, integer sequences, and rationals in approximation.

children.periodEn: Ancient traditions; systematization in the seventeenth–nineteenth centuries

children.descriptionZh: 利用级数、复分析和概率研究素数分布与加性问题。
children.descriptionEn: Series, complex analysis, and probability in prime distribution and additive questions.

children.descriptionZh: 黎曼 ζ 函数、L 函数与素数计数的联系。
children.descriptionEn: Connections between the Riemann zeta function, L-functions, and prime counting.

children.descriptionZh: 解析估计、加性数论以及数的无理性与超越性。
children.descriptionEn: Analytic estimates, additive number theory, irrationality, and transcendence.

children.periodZh: 18世纪起步；19世纪形成现代方法
children.periodEn: Origins in the eighteenth century; modern methods formed in the nineteenth

sources.title: University of St Andrews, MacTutor: Prime numbers

children.descriptionZh: 代数整数与理想将整数算术推广到数域。
children.descriptionEn: Algebraic integers and ideals extend integer arithmetic to number fields.

children.descriptionZh: 数域、整环、理想类群及单位的算术。
children.descriptionEn: Arithmetic of number fields, domains, ideal class groups, and units.

children.en: Local and global arithmetic and reciprocity
children.descriptionZh: 赋值、p 进数、阿代尔与类域理论连接局部和整体信息。
children.descriptionEn: Valuations, p-adic numbers, adeles, and class field theory connecting local and global information.

children.periodEn: Formation in the nineteenth century; development in the twentieth

sources.title: University of St Andrews, MacTutor: The development of Ring Theory

children.descriptionZh: 代数曲线与模形式将数论、几何和表示论联系起来。
children.descriptionEn: Algebraic curves and modular forms linking number theory, geometry, and representation theory.

children.descriptionZh: 椭圆曲线的算术、模曲线与自守形式。
children.descriptionEn: Arithmetic of elliptic curves, modular curves, and automorphic forms.

children.zh: 现代算术几何与朗兰兹纲领
children.en: Modern arithmetic geometry and the Langlands program
children.descriptionZh: 概形、上同调与表示之间的算术联系。
children.descriptionEn: Arithmetic links between schemes, cohomology, and representations.

children.periodZh: 19世纪椭圆函数起源；20世纪以来统一发展
children.periodEn: Origins in nineteenth-century elliptic functions; unifying developments since the twentieth century

sources.title: University of St Andrews, MacTutor: Prime numbers

roots.descriptionZh: 从计数和有限配置问题，发展到图、序与离散计算结构。
roots.descriptionEn: From counting and finite configurations to graphs, orders, and discrete computational structures.

children.descriptionZh: 古典计数问题逐步形成系统的枚举和结构方法。
children.descriptionEn: Classical counting problems developing into systematic enumerative and structural methods.

children.descriptionZh: 加乘原理、排列组合、生成函数和递推。
children.descriptionEn: Addition and product principles, permutations, combinations, generating functions, and recurrences.

children.descriptionZh: 利用代数、概率和极值思想研究有限结构，并列出组合方法在化学合成中的应用。
children.descriptionEn: Algebraic, probabilistic, and extremal approaches to finite structures, with an application of combinatorial methods to chemical synthesis.

children.periodZh: 古典问题传统；17—19世纪方法发展
children.periodEn: Classical problem traditions; method development in the seventeenth–nineteenth centuries

children.descriptionZh: 由路径和配置问题发展为图结构及网络的理论。
children.descriptionEn: Path and configuration problems developing into theories of graph structure and networks.

children.descriptionZh: 顶点、边的组合及图的结构、映射和乘积。
children.descriptionEn: Combinations of vertices and edges, graph structures, maps, and products.

children.descriptionZh: 图上的遍历、染色、匹配与有限配置问题。
children.descriptionEn: Traversal, coloring, matching, and finite configuration problems.

children.descriptionZh: 大网络的统计结构及图模型在动力学与算法中的应用。
children.descriptionEn: Statistical structure of large networks and graph models in dynamics and algorithms.

children.periodZh: 18世纪问题起源；19—20世纪形成理论
children.periodEn: Problem origins in the eighteenth century; theory developed in the nineteenth–twentieth centuries

sources.title: University of St Andrews, MacTutor: Mathematical games

children.descriptionZh: 把比较关系推广为偏序、格及其拓扑与逻辑接口。
children.descriptionEn: Generalizing comparison relations to partial orders, lattices, and their topological and logical interfaces.

children.descriptionZh: 偏序、上下界、链与反链。
children.descriptionEn: Partial orders, bounds, chains, and antichains.

children.descriptionZh: 格运算、对偶性与不动点，及其在语义和拓扑中的应用。
children.descriptionEn: Lattice operations, dualities, and fixed points in semantics and topology.

children.periodZh: 19世纪序结构起源；20世纪格论发展
children.periodEn: Nineteenth-century order structures; twentieth-century lattice theory

children.descriptionZh: 离散结构进入形式语言、有限状态模型和信息编码。
children.descriptionEn: Discrete structures in formal languages, finite-state models, and information coding.

children.descriptionZh: 字符串、文法和有限状态转换系统。
children.descriptionEn: Strings, grammars, and finite-state transition systems.

children.descriptionZh: 有限域、线性码以及离散算术中的算法方法。
children.descriptionEn: Finite fields, linear codes, and algorithms for discrete arithmetic.

children.zh: 计算复杂性与离散搜索
children.descriptionZh: 问题的可计算资源要求、复杂性类别，以及离散状态空间的搜索。
children.descriptionEn: Computational resources required by problems, complexity classes, and searches of discrete state spaces.
children.periodEn: Formation and development in the later twentieth century
Formation and development in the twentieth century

sources.title: University of St Andrews, MacTutor: Mathematical games
